LanguageData.DungeonSpeed.label: dungeon speed
LanguageData.DungeonSpeed.description:
The speed at which this person can navigate a dungeon.

As the pawn reaches a higher Intellectual level, dungeon yield increases because the pawn can explore deeper dungeons with more loot, but dungeon speed decreases because looting higher-level dungeons takes longer. The average wealth gained for the time spent is still better at higher levels.

Dungeon speed can be improved by building dungeon upgrades from the Misc category.
LanguageData.DungeonYield.label: dungeon yield
LanguageData.DungeonYield.description: The amount of loot this person can find in dungeons.\n\nAs the pawn reaches a higher Intellectual level, dungeon yield increases because the pawn can explore deeper dungeons with more loot, but dungeon speed decreases because looting higher-level dungeons takes longer. The average wealth gained for the time spent is still better at higher levels.
